questions.question: What should this session work on next: BK-510 (dialogs asked again after their answer went to another session's log) or the remaining OP-01 open items O66 to O72?

options.label: BK-510 first (Recommended)
options.description: Fix the dialog tooling first so the O66 to O71 walk can't produce new silent double answers. Orient, then settle its open decision (check before asking, report double answers, or both). Then the OP-01 reopen.

options.label: OP-01 O66 to O72 first
options.description: Finish the OP-01 reopen now, while the context is fresh. A worker restart during the walk could create new double answers that nothing detects.

options.label: Only O68 (S3 ETag) first
options.description: Verify D62's S3 premise against botocore or a real run before anything else. If it's wrong, it changes D43's deviation and possibly more decisions, so the other reopens would rest on a corrected base.

questions.question: What should this session work on next: BK-510 (dialogs asked again after their answer went to another session's log) or the remaining OP-01 open items O66 to O72?
BK-510 scope: armed /observe sessions can't read sdd/decisions/, and worker restarts file answers under the 07bd66b7 log. Which remedy should BK-510 ship?

options.label: Both (Recommended)
options.description: Hook: at arm and rearm, list the open items of this entry that a dialog in sdd/decisions/ already answered but the record doesn't record, so the session writes from them instead of asking again. observe_dialogs: report split dialogs (asked and answered under different session ids) and items answered in more than one dialog, for /observe-review's readers. Recorder unchanged.

options.label: Hook check only
options.description: Prevents asking again in future sessions. Doesn't report the double answers already committed, or End-check dialogs that name no item. Review still sees reworded re-asks only as unpaired dialogs.

options.label: Report only
options.description: Cheapest: observe_dialogs flags double answers at review time. Doesn't prevent anything: the next /observe OP-01 would still ask O66 to O69 again and could get different answers.

questions.question: How should the hook hand an armed /observe session the answers it already has (the 'check before asking' half)?

options.label: Context at arm/rearm (Recommended)
options.description: arm (UserPromptSubmit) and rearm (SessionStart, which also fires after a worker restart) print the answered-but-unrecorded items, quoting each question and answer. Skill step 3: write such an item from that answer, Asked line quoting it, and ask again only if the scenario changed, naming the earlier answer. Blocks nothing.

options.label: Refuse the re-ask
options.description: check (PreToolUse) refuses an AskUserQuestion that names an item already answered in a log, quoting the earlier answer. Stricter, but it needs a way past the refusal for a deliberate re-ask, and a refusal costs the session a turn.
